title: 10mL water reciprocal 1000J cycle; open
script:
register lv3
add v1 water 10mL
inspect
cool v1 1000J
inspect
heat v1 1000J
inspect
measure v1 thermometer
expectation: A supported reciprocal cycle returns the initial25C within0.2K and conserves whole inventory. If the coupled phase domain cannot support the dose, refuse atomically and disclose the boundary rather than publish a successful false energy closure.
criteria: Accepted pure-water phase steps expose an established sensible/latent split.
Supported cycles return25C within0.2K; water conservation within1e-8mol.
Unsupported domain exits preserve the pre-operation complete physical state.

title: 10mL sealed water reciprocal 5000J; supported-domain check
script:

add v1 water 10mL
seal v1 100mL
inspect
cool v1 5000J
inspect
heat v1 5000J
inspect
measure v1 thermometer
expectation: Deep cooling that reaches an explicitly unsupported solvent-activity range must refuse the whole proposal without claiming its complete energy dose. Modest supported solution cycles must preserve atoms; an unpriced chemical energy partition must be explicit, rather than certified as pure sensible heat.
criteria: An unsupported phase-domain refusal is distinct from physical agreement with the entire calorimetric cycle.
Complete accepted phase/reaction partition must have independent energy evidence; otherwise typed/narrated coverage is incomplete.
Every successful physical transfer conserves material; every domain refusal is atomic.
